Return to planner

Engineering field guide

The browser and native Lua runtimes share a quest-service planner. The local journal and map use the same costed route.

Components

Journal commands→QuestPlannerFacade→Worker adapter→Lua planning service
Route result→Playback checkpoints→Map, journal and itinerary

Factory Method and Strategy

The common creator runs the object returned by its own creation method. Each specialized creator supplies an interchangeable strategy.

Creator.run()callscreateStrategy()thenstrategy.calculate()
Atlas creator
Constructs a three-service lookahead over feasible coverage states.
Exact creator
Constructs a bounded precedence- and resource-aware Held–Karp solver.
Nearest creator
Constructs a single-step eligible-service heuristic.

Optimize Route

  1. The UI executes the optimize command on the facade.
  2. The worker passes the request to the Lua validation chain.
  3. The service graph retains unfinished activities and their dependencies.
  4. The chosen strategy uses Dijkstra connectors. The planner reconstructs each weighted edge.
  5. The facade publishes the result. Playback creates immutable progress checkpoints, and the map draws the returned legs.
